name: Whispering Willow Labyrinth
description: A maze of towering willows whose leaves murmur ancient stories; pathways glow faintly with embedded moonstones guiding wanderers.
prompt: Overhead view of a sprawling labyrinth formed by colossal weeping willows. Leaves shimmer with tiny moonstone glints. Soft mist curls around trunks. Pathways illuminated by subtle bioluminescent moss. Cinematic lighting, high detail, 8k.
caption: Listen closely — the walls tell tales. 🌿🗝️ #WhisperingWillowLabyrinth
